en-GB.codex_commander_caesar_lore_text:
Caesar leads armies with wordless dignity. His mere presence is enough to inspire and guide troops through battle. 

Caesar was born in a litter of three on the summer solstice. Each pup was promised to the youngest child of a noble family, and while his sisters were homed far across the seas, Caesar remained in Cherrystone, where he became Mercia's much beloved pet and best friend.

Caesar's closest companions outside the royal household are his crossbow-wielding personal guards, Horatio and Beatrice. As well as protecting Caesar on the battlefield, they also provide mid-combat belly rubs and ear scratches as required.
en-GB.codex_commander_caesar_summary:
A Queen's Best Friend 

▶ Mercia’s beloved companion.
▶ Adored by his handlers Horatio
  and Beatrice.
▶ Brother of Crassia and Pompeia
  (separated soon after birth).
en-GB.codex_commander_darkmercia_lore_text1:
『 3 March 3043 』

▶ Half a year has passed and I am still beset by nightmares. I thought destroying Requiem would purge the darkness from my soul. But still I wake, screaming in the night and gasping for breath.
en-GB.codex_commander_darkmercia_lore_text2: ▶ I have killed this Darkness hundreds of times in these dreams of mine, yet still she persists. Will I ever be free?
en-GB.codex_commander_darkmercia_lore_text3:
Weeks ago, I saw a little girl weeping by a gravestone. She did not notice me, nor the darkness that surrounded her, threatening to swallow her whole.

--“First mother. Now father, too.” The girl sobbed as the darkness loomed overhead.

--“Come with me!” I bade her. “I’ll protect you.”
--“You…? But *you* keep killing me.”

I froze. The girl turned to look at me, her eyes full of fear. Suddenly, the Darkness around her rose up and transformed into the demon I have fought every night for a year. She aimed her sword at my heart.

--“I… I’m sorry.” I whispered. My voice cracked. I knew not else to do. I fell at her feet. I hugged her legs. “I’m sorry. I’m sorry. I’m sorry.”

A pause. Then, a warmth from within. The girl’s protector dropped her sword and fell to meet my embrace. 

I awoke with the dawn at my window. 

I’ve had no nightmares since.
en-GB.codex_commander_darkmercia_summary:
Queen's Shadow

Age:     6, in a sense.
Height:   Looms large.
Birthday: A cold day at the grave.
en-GB.codex_commander_elodie_lore_text:
Records show that in life, Elodie wielded a lute called Pavane.

Growing up, Elodie heard marvelous tales of the Silent Dancers of Silmor, and longed to play music for them with her brother Harmon.

Just as soon as the war ends.
en-GB.codex_commander_elodie_summary:
Princess of Cacophony

▶ Twin sister to Prince Harmon.
  Would-be sister-in-law to Prince
  Sordino of Silmor.
▶ Sacrificed herself to seal away
  Requiem, a dangerous weapon
  that enslaves minds.
▶ Several milennia later, Elodie’s 
  spirit was slain by Queen Mercia.
en-GB.codex_commander_emeric_lore1_text:
Emeric is the youngest son of a noble Cherrystone family. He had a somewhat solitary childhood with twin siblings 15 years his senior.

From a young age, Emeric showed a deep interest in arcane magical arts. He often borrowed old tomes from his family’s Grand Library, which is where he would meet his lifelong friend, Mercival II—the future King of Cherrystone.
en-GB.codex_commander_emeric_lore2_text: Emeric gained another cherished companion in the wake of tragedy. After Emperor Hayate of Heavensong was killed, Emeric and Mercival began making thrice-yearly trips east to support the young Empress Tenri. Once Mercia was born, Emeric made these social visits alone, and far less frequently.
en-GB.codex_commander_emeric_summary:
Archmage - Royal Advisor

▶ Most powerful mage in Aurania.
▶ Kindhearted scholar.
▶ Lifelong best friend of the late
  King Mercival II .
▶ Loving mentor to Queen Mercia,
  the late king’s daughter.
en-GB.codex_commander_errol_lore_text:
A self-taught mage, Errol devours every magic tome Wulfar can find for him, and practises his spell-casting constantly. 

Sir Emeric of Cherrystone has said there’s a spot for Errol at Cherrystone’s Alchemist training academy, but Errol is uncertain. Sure, it’s lonely learning everything on his own. But there’s freedom in being unbeholden to any particular school of thought.
en-GB.codex_commander_errol_summary:
▶ Orla's twin brother; Wulfar's son.
▶ A self-taught mage.
▶ Pancake enjoyer.
▶ Good friends with Koji of Heavensong.
en-GB.codex_commander_greenfinger_lore_text:
Greenfinger Zawan rules the Floran Tribes with strength and compassion. 
Zawan was born with the ability to produce and manipulate plants at will—an ability uncommon even among the Floran.
Once a generation, a Floran with the potential to become a Greenfinger is born. Zawan trained under his predecessor Greenfinger Russom for 22 years—yet when Russom died at the age of 212, Zawan felt there was still much to learn. 
Though a new Greenfinger is yet to be born, Zawan has taken on a young protegee: Nuru, a visitor from a distant tribe. The two enjoy thrilling sparring matches and hours-long discussion on life. It will be a sad day indeed when Nuru goes back to her home… wherever that is.
en-GB.codex_commander_greenfinger_summary:
Greenfinger of the Floran Tribes

▶ Beloved ruler of the Floran
  Tribes for the past 90 years.
▶ Strong and compassionate.
▶ Can manipulate plants at will.
▶ Currently missing.
en-GB.codex_commander_koji_lore_text:
With his grandparents gone and his parents busy in their duties as Empress and Consort, Koji spent much of his early childhood cared for by his great aunt Mari, and his personal protector ‘uncle’ Shōsa. From Mari, Koji learned a love of engineering. From Shōsa, he learned how to sit outside and enjoy a good breeze.

At 11 years old, Koji would finally meet a pair of friends his own age… right as they were breaking into his home. With Errol and Orla by his side, Koji’s 12th year was by far his happiest. 

Now that he’s 13 and legally capable of assuming responsibilities of the throne, Koji hardly has time to write his friends, let alone meet them.

Despite the weighty expectations placed upon him as heir to the Heavensong Empire, Koji is, by all appearances, an optimist.

en-GB.codex_commander_mercia_lore_text:
▶ Mercia has ruled the Cherrystone Kingdom for more than three years now. 

▶ Though she feels more at home on the battlefield than in the royal study, Mercia has gained valuable wisdom and insight under the tutelage of her advisor and longtime family friend, Emeric.

▶ After Mercia’s mother died, Emeric's steady, quietly loving presence kept the six-year-old and her father going. Mercia and Emeric support each other on more equal footing since the passing of King Mercival.
en-GB.codex_commander_mercia_summary:
Queen of Cherrystone

▶ Daughter of the late King
  Mercival II.
▶ In 3042, defeated Sigrid, Elodie,
  and the ancient weapon Requiem.
▶ Organised the first treaty
  involving all four nations of
  Aurania.
en-GB.codex_commander_mercival_lore_text:
King Mercival II ruled Cherrystone for several decades. He was much beloved by his people, and even more so by his daughter Mercia. 

Mercival and Emeric met as boys in the Grand Library of Emeric’s family estate. Mercival's childhood had been happy but lonely up to this point. So, when the 10-year-old prince met the 8-year-old lordling, things changed for the better. There was barely a moment when one boy was not staying at the other's house. These days would form some of Emeric's fondest memories.

By his nineteenth year, Mercival had long considered Emeric a brother. So it was no surprise that Emeric was by Mercival’s side at his mother’s funeral. After the ceremony, Mercival sat down with his friend under an old oak tree in the courtyard.

“Once I’m King, I might not have time to visit your estate...” 

Emeric nodded solemnly, a pit forming in his stomach. He was dreading this.

“...So you’ll just have to move in here! If that’s all right? There’s plenty of room. And books! And—”

Emeric agreed without hesitation, and began living full-time at the palace as the young king’s official advisor.

en-GB.codex_commander_nuru_lore_text:
Nuru is a lively, intelligent and courageous commander whose skills are out of this world.

Unbeknownst to the Floran, Nuru hails not only from a different tribe, but a different star system entirely. They've stayed longer than intended, but they're planning their return voyage soon.
en-GB.codex_commander_nuru_summary:
Extraterrestrial Visitor

▶ Keeps outer-space origins

▶ Friendly, feisty; clever and
  quick-witted. Highly valued

▶ Helped Queen Mercia destroy

en-GB.codex_commander_orla_lore_text:
Orla got her first slingshot at the age of three, and the first thing she did with it was throw it very hard at Errol. After telling her off, putting her in time out and making sure she apologised to her brother, Wulfar then carefully explained to her how to use it properly. Having done that, he gave her a bag of marshmallows to practise with.

The rest, as they say, is history.

While exploring near the Gloomwoods one day, Orla accidentally fired a shot at Nuru, who yelled “Nice one!” and promised to show Orla 'something better than a slingshot' someday soon.
en-GB.codex_commander_orla_summary:
▶ Errol's twin sister; Wulfar's daughter
▶ Plays rough; fights fair
▶ Wants to see the world
▶ Good friends with Koji of Heavensong
en-GB.codex_commander_pistil_lore_text:
Disturbing news from the Senate. Following the passing of Senator Samt-al-Ras, numerous allegations of corruption and impropriety have come to light. 
Key evidence for these allegations has been preserved by the senator's son, Sepal. Details are expected to be revealed following the investigation later this year.

"I wish peace and justice for all those harmed by my father's actions," said Sepal Samt-al-Ras.

The late senator's estranged daughter could not be reached for comment.
en-GB.codex_commander_ragna_lore_text:
Created by Valder to be the ultimate commander, Ragna Valdersdottur is a patchwork assembly of the best parts of history's greatest warriors. She strives to be the baddest she can be. Though she claims to be Queen Mercia's dedicated adversary, one wonders if ‘playmate’ is a more accurate term.

Beyond anything else, Ragna longs to impress her creator and make him proud of her. Unfortunately, Valder isn’t the sort to outwardly express pride or affection.

For the past couple years, Ragna has been training under Vesper in the ways of Fumomancy, but progress is… slow. In fairness to Ragna, she’s technically just eight years old—and barely a teenager in mind.
en-GB.codex_commander_ragna_summary:
Felheim's Top Commander

▶ Assembled from the remains of
  Felheim’s greatest warriors.
▶ Currently learning Fumomancy
  (smoke magic) from Vesper.
▶ Just wants to make her father
  proud.
en-GB.codex_commander_ryota_lore_text:
Ryota was born to an impoverished community in Southern Heavensong. Ryota showed such aptitude at only four years old that the entire village raised the funds to send him to the Imperial City for education. 

When the Felheim invasion began two years into his education, Ryota was terrified to be so far from home. But he carried on. When the famines hit, Ryota redoubled his efforts to perform at school and provide for his village. When the Emperor was killed and the lands erupted in turmoil, the six-year-old Ryota swallowed everything to become a rock for his family, village, and country. 

After graduating at 16, Ryota quickly rose through the ranks of the Heavensong military. At 22, Ryota lost his legs during a border skirmish, but even this could not deter him. Ryota sought out the legendary swordsmith Takeshi to forge and fit him with bladed prosthetics.

Ryota’s dedication has earned him the favour of the Empress herself. Ryota’s parents and older brother now reside within the walls of the Imperial Palace, their lives cared for for the rest of their days.
en-GB.codex_commander_ryota_summary:
Heavensong Admiral

▶ Empress Tenri’s most trusted
  commander.
▶ Felled Sedge in combat while
  defending the Heavensong
  Empire.
▶ Wears prosthetic, bladed legs
  forged of Takeshi steel.
en-GB.codex_commander_sedge_lore_text:
A former Commander for the Floran Tribes, known for their ruthless hunting methods and sadistic personality. Sedge was banished from the Tribes after deceiving Greenfinger Zawan and attacking Cherrystone refugees. 

Sedge fell to Ryota in 3042, in a battle unrelated to the Requiem Incident.

As with Sigrid, there is a dedicated group of individuals who swear loyalty to Sedge even after death. All across Aurania, there are fearful whispers of a mysterious ring of assassins calling themselves the Hunter’s Underground Network.
en-GB.codex_commander_sedge_summary:
Sadistic Hunter
[ Deceased ]

▶ Disgraced Floran commander.
▶ Killed by Ryota of Heavensong.
en-GB.codex_commander_sigrid_lore_text:
On a quiet night in 3042, Sigrid killed King Mercival II, sparking a war between Felheim and Cherrystone. Sigrid used the ensuing chaos to search for the ancient Cacophony relic, Requiem. She was defeated mere steps from her goal.

Despite Sigrid’s death, there are those in Aurania who devote their lives to defending her name and honour. They meet every third tuesday.

One member swears to have seen an elegant High Vampire appear one night at the group’s official memorial shrine. They insist this must have been Sigrid, blessing the squadron for their hard work. But one wonders if ▶another▶ High Vampire may have reason to pay respects...
en-GB.codex_commander_sigrid_summary:
High Vamipire of the West
[ Deceased ]

▶ A once-trusted Felheim
  commander.
▶ Killed King Mercival II in pursuit
  of the ancient weapon Requiem.
▶ Fell to Queen Mercia during the
  Requiem Incident of 3042.
en-GB.codex_commander_tenri_lore_text:
Tenri ascended the Heavensong throne at just 15 years old, in the aftermath of an unprovoked invasion by King Kaspar of Felheim. The Fell King and his armies were slain, but not before Tenri’s parents were cut down—her mother, defending the Imperial city. Her father, before her very eyes. Tenri is here today because of the loving support from her remaining family, her friends Emeric and Mercival, and her son Koji.

Since that tragic day, Tenri has dedicated her life to upholding her father’s imperial legacy, her mother’s protection of the royal house—and ensuring that her son is safeguarded from the dangers of the world.

Tenri's ability to muster and manipulate wind is a skill passed down to her by her mother. It is the ancient family secret of a noble Heavensong house. The fans she wields, too, are an heirloom of that ancestry. The secret of this skill is closely guarded, and none but its practitioners know whether it is born of magic or science.
en-GB.codex_commander_tenri_summary:

▶ Rules nearly a dozen colonies,

▶ Mother to Prince Koji.
▶ Dear friend to Emeric and

Empress of Heavensong

en-GB.codex_commander_valder_lore_text:
Valder Ragnarsson is the ruler of Felheim, and wielder of the Fell Gauntlet, an ancient Cacophony artefact that enables one to command the undead. 

Valder was born in a quiet township, where he lived a relatively quiet life--until The Fallow returned to Felheim.

When Valder was 10 years old, Felheim’s ruler was killed during an unprovoked invasion of Heavensong. Upon his death, the Fell Gauntlet vanished, dragging Felheim back into the terror of Fallow. 

With no wielder to control it, the Gauntlet itself takes control, driving the undead mad and making them cut down friend and foe alike.

The night the last Fallow began, Valder’s village was burned to the ground by a lawless horde of living and undead. Valder escaped with the few other children who survived the attack. Valder travelled with them for a time. But by the fourth year of Fallow, Valder was alone. 

With no one else to rely on, Valder hardened his heart. He taught himself to fight.

On the night of his eighteenth birthday, Valder laid in restless slumber, besieged by visions of a hand engulfed in violet flame. When he awoke, he was lying supine on the surface of a frozen lake, a weighty gauntlet upon his left hand.
en-GB.codex_commander_valder_summary:
Fell Lord of Felheim

▶ Grand necromancer.
▶ Ragna’s creator.
▶ Wields the Fell Gauntlet, giving
  him the right to rule Felheim.
▶ Helped Mercia destroy the 
  ancient weapon Requiem in 3042.
en-GB.codex_commander_vesper_lore_text:
Vesper and Wulfar grew up together as best friends in a large Outlaw clan. When they were 15, the pair met the most charming girl either had ever seen: Alia. 

The three quickly became close, but it was soon obvious that Vesper and Wulfar were both competing for Alia’s time and affection.

When Vesper recognized her own feelings, she instinctively withdrew for fear of being abandoned. On the night Vesper at last mustered the courage to confess her love, she found herself fifteen minutes too late. Wulfar had just finished his own confession, and he and Alia were locked in embrace.

Panic, embarrassment, shame overwhelmed Vesper—she fled the clan that very night, after nearly suffocating Wulfar and Alia in a rage-induced cloud of smoke. 

Since then, Vesper’s life has been one self-inflicted disaster after another. Case in point: two years ago, Vesper returned to her old clan's territory, intending to make amends with Wulfar and Alia. However, when she learned of Alia’s passing, and of Wulfar’s apparent happy life despite that loss--Vesper was overcome with disgust, and launched headfirst into her latest scheme.
en-GB.codex_commander_vesper_summary:
Convicted Pet-napper

▶ Skilled in Fumomancy (smoke
  magic)—a closely guarded
  family secret.
▶ Kidnapped Errol & Orla’s cat.
▶ Banished to Felheim; currently
  teaching fumomancy to Ragna.
▶ Estranged former friend to
  Wulfar and his late wife Alia.
en-GB.codex_commander_wulfar_lore_text:
Standing at over 7 feet tall, Wulfar cuts an imposing figure on the battlefield. But his patience, intelligence, and immovable resolve render him a truly terrifying foe and an amazing father.

Wulfar will forever remember the night he lost his best friend. It is one of his happiest and most horrible memories. 

Anyone could see for miles that Vesper fancied Alia. A loyal friend, Wulfar waited patiently for Vesper to gather the strength to confess. But oh, was waiting hard. When Vesper seemingly lost interest, all the powerful emotions Wulfar had been holding in came rushing out. He had to see her. He had to tell her.

Alas, Wulfar lost a good friend that eve. But he set on a new path with the love of his life. Would that he'd had more time--with Alia and Vesper both.
en-GB.codex_commander_wulfar_summary:
Outlaw Chief

▶ Father to Errol & Orla; loving
  husband to his late wife Alia.
▶ Former friend to Vesper.
▶ Leads the largest Outlaw clan
  in Aurania.
en-GB.codex_groove_strategy_lytra:
Song Cyclone can open up rigid enemy formations. You can also use it to defeat powerful ground units by dropping them into the sea or on top of structures. (Note that Lytra cannot reposition commanders.)

Be careful: Lytra’s groove moves her own units as well, and this may expose her to lethal enemy attacks.
en-GB.codex_groove_strategy_nadia:
Nadia's groove can deal high damage to powerful enemies - but because it selects targets at random, try to position Nadia in a way that increases the odds of striking the units you want. 

For example: Nadia’s Charge I groove affects 3 enemy units. If there are only three enemies in range, Nadia’s groove is guaranteed to hit them all. 

If there are 6 units in range, there’s a 50% chance of striking a specific unit.
en-GB.codex_groove_strategy_pistil:
Pistil’s groove deals devastating damage to large chains of enemies - and she can use her own units to make these chains even longer. 

Chain Reaction leaves enemies with at least 10 health, so ensure you have units around to remove the weakened enemies from play.
en-GB.codex_groove_strategy_rhomb:
Rhomb’s Crystal Heart allows them to move again, and with additional movement range - making them a threat to any exposed commander or unit. 

At Charge II, Rhomb can also strike units at range - even Air and Naval units! Though Rhomb is powerful in their crystal form, they’re not invulnerable. Ensure they can make it back to safety when their groove wears off.

en-GB.unit_description_commander_darkmercia: The Queen of Cherrystone's cruel and merciless counterpoint.

en-GB.unit_description_commander_emeric: This learned and powerful mage is the trusted advisor of the rulers of Cherrystone.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_greenfinger: This wise chief of the Floran Tribes has power over plants, and puts it to good use in battle.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_koji: The Prince of Heavensong, and a child prodigy. Rides into battle on Tenko, his finest creation.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_mercia: The heroic queen of Cherrystone. Fights for her people with the mighty Cherryblade.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_mercival: The noble King of Cherrystone. A just and wise ruler.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_nadia: Dread pirate. Scourge of the Saffron Isles.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_nuru: This visitor to the lands of the Floran tribes is a strong, clever and spirited hunter.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_ragna: Felheim's patchwork general, built to sow death and destruction.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_ryota: A chivalrous, strategic and dexterous warrior. Leads every branch of Heavensong's military.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_sedge: A capable but vicious Floran general who cuts a shadowy figure.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_sigrid: The High Vampire of Western Felheim. She is ancient, smart and savage.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_tenri: The graceful Empress of Heavensong. Uses her fans to sculpt the wind.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_twins: Orla is a sharpshooter, Errol is a wizard, and together they are a real force to be reckoned with.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_valder: The ruler of the Felheim Legion. Uses the Fell Gauntlet to command the undead.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_vesper: This felonious fumomancer will stop at nothing to accomplish her awful ambitions.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_wulfar: A towering figure in more ways than one, Wulfar is the respected chief of a vast outlaw clan.
